design_archetype: Swiss High-Contrast Precision & Italian Atelier Warmth

core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Swiss grid precision meets Italian studio craftsmanship
Emotion First: Purposeful clarity, tangible status tracking, trustworthy financial feedback
Content is King: Italian editorial typography hierarchy with high data legibility
Contrast & Negative Space: Clear row division, high contrast badges, explicit focus states

components.name: NavigationHeader
components.description: Sticky top bar with branding, tab switches, dark/light theme toggle, current team member profile

components.name: StatsDashboard
components.description: KPI grid displaying total fatturato completati, per-person earning breakdown (charts/progress bars), active workload summary

components.name: GeneralWorkTable
components.description: Interactive data table with filter toolbar (by team member and by status), search input, sorting by date/price, and inline status dropdowns

components.name: CompletedFolder
components.description: Archived 'Cartella Completati' view displaying all confezionati jobs with total archived value, date completed, and restore option

components.name: ListManager
components.description: Settings view to add/edit/delete job categories ('Tipi di Lavoro') and team members ('Membri del Team') with color badges

components.name: WorkFormModal
components.description: Modal dialog to create or edit a job order with type selection, client price input, due date calendar picker, assignee select, and progress selector

components.name: AuthModal
components.description: Login / Sign up view with support for team account switching

testing_and_data_ids.rule: Every interactive button, input, select, tab, modal, and key numeric display MUST have a unique role-based data-testid in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user-facing text is in Italian ('Italiano').
Do NOT use TypeScript .tsx extension in frontend imports or components; stick strictly to React JavaScript (.js / .jsx).
Use Lucide-React icons for UI indicators (e.g. CheckCircle2, FolderCheck, Users, Euro, Calendar, Plus, Filter, Search, Moon, Sun).
Use Shadcn UI components provided in src/components/ui/ (Dialog, Table, Select, Badge, Button, Input, Progress, Tabs, Card, DropdownMenu, Sonner Toasts).
Never use generic Inter font for main headers. Pair Outfit/Plus Jakarta Sans for headings with JetBrains Mono for monetary values.
Ensure dark mode support with slate-950 background and slate-900 cards.
Verify that every interactive element includes its corresponding data-testid attribute.

Provide seed data in Italian with realistic team members (e.g., Marco Rossi, Giulia Bianchi, Alessandro Serra, Sofia Conti), job types (e.g., Grafica, Sviluppo Web, Contabilità, Confezionamento, Consulenza), realistic client prices, and due dates.
